title: Chale ho kis pe
body:
abbas mere bhai
chale ho kis pe shahe deen ko chod kar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
qadam qadam pe rahe saath umr bhar abbas
chale ho kis pe shahe deen ko chod kar abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
ye jaante ho sakina ka haal kya hoga
palat ke aaye na darya se tum agar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi hai nauha kuna aur koi tadapta hai
bana hai dard ki tasweer ghar ka ghar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
na jaane kya hua saakit hai bolti hi nahi
palat ke dekhlo zainab ko ek nazar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
khabar na hogi tumhe tum to so rahe honge
jab hogi zainab e dilgeer dar badar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
gaye jo tum suye maqtal zuban se kuch na kaha
khade na reh sake sibte nabi magar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
raha na ek bhi suraj hussain ke ghar mein
na hogi shaam e ghariban ki ab sahar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhare baad jo hona tha wo hua aakhir
hussain mar gaye zainab hai nange sar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
<<DIVIDER>>
wafa shiyaron mein hashim ka naam aajaye
bas ek nazre karam mujhpe ho agar abbas
chale ho kis pe...
author: Hashim Raza
